templates_owner_scope_consistent.name: templates_owner_scope_consistent
templates_owner_scope_consistent.value: ("templates"."owner_type" = 'platform' AND "templates"."organization_id" IS NULL) OR ("templates"."owner_type" = 'organization' AND "templates"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL)
